news_risk: No adverse regulatory action or negative news found for the Indian entity. Note: a separate US entity, GKN Aerospace (Garden Grove, California), was subject of a May 2026 hazardous-materials incident and an Orange County DA civil action with a $125M settlement finalised 19 Oct 2026 and a court-approved claims programme up to $100M (sources: ggcity.org/hazmat-incident; ocdistrictattorney.gov press releases). This concerns GKN Aerospace in the USA, not GKN Driveline (India) Ltd, and is recorded for group-context only. No Indian regulator action located.
rf_supply: No evidence found. Indian Kanoon full-text search for 'GKN Driveline Russia' returned zero matching results; no public record of supplies to Russia or CIS located. Note: GKN Automotive is a UK-headquartered group that publicly exited its Russian operations after 2022 (group-level statement, not verified in this session) — treat as unconfirmed.
note: Sanctions: no designation found for GKN Driveline (India) Ltd on OFAC SDN/Non-SDN, UN, EU, UK or BIS lists. Caveat: the OFAC Sanctions List Search page (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov) is JavaScript-driven and returned no query results to this tool, and the DuckDuckGo search backend was unavailable (connection refused), so the sanctions check is based on absence of any designation reference in accessible sources rather than a completed name-screen — recommend a manual re-screen. Court cases: extensive but overwhelmingly the company as petitioner/appellant in tax, GST, excise, electricity-tariff, land and labour matters — ordinary commercial litigation, not a rejection ground per project rules. Credit rating: no public rating (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings) located; field left null rather than inferred. No legal-identity, HS-code or shipment-volume research performed per role scope.
